notes.title: Soccer Tournament 2018 is Here!
notes.content:
Play the game your way! Mini World is a free-to-play sandbox game where players explore and create fun 3D playlands together. 

[b][list]
[*]Limited Time Soccer Events! Create your own Mini World Cup (Hint: you can make jetpack a requirement in your soccer game)!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/4ec7d17288b700b6c2640c5fe32187526923d9a2.gif[/img]
[*]Customizable Avatar with additional animations.  
[*]Lamp blocks can light your world at night - a great gift for the hopeless romantics,
[*]Fly with your cute pet Dango
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/9b3f8d675a78cab670661015ace38a0b8038dd7b.gif[/img]
[*]Day/Night cycle in the beautiful Mini World 
[*]Majestic buildings build by the community
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/5db481bbbccaa053d5f168cafde2a2f8044d3530.gif[/img]
[*]Build your own rollercoaster, sky is the limit!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/68bc3855a935cb7c76f929d313b0ca322b2972e7.gif[/img]
[*]Enormous Sandbox World – explore an expansive sandbox world with a variety of unique monsters, blocks, materials, and mines. Start an adventure in unknown caves and vast underworld. 
[*]Powerful engine allows players play in a stable environment
[*]Gallery - You can upload or download maps in the Gallery, have a look at the hottest MOD map and games made by other player
[*]Lots of game modes - Survival mode, Creation mode or mini games  
[*]Powerful game-editor - there are various types of mini-games, from parkour, to puzzle, to FPS, to strategy and much more. All these can be easily made by the built-in game-editor
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/b289e872128fbede7346157d85eab896bd69f4a7.gif[/img]
[/list][/b]

[h1]Game Modes[/h1]

[b]Survival Mode[/b]
In Survival Mode, players need to gather resources, build shelters, tools and fight for survival. After getting enough resources, go explore the wild with friends. Explore vast caves, pet pandas in bamboo forests, or challenge the black dragon in the underworld. This easy to pick up mode is a great way to learn the game mechanics and immerse yourself in a vast open world full of adventures! 

[b]Creation Mode[/b]
Sky is the limit. In creation mode, players are given most of the resources right at the start to build anything they want. You can create a giant city, a beautiful resort on a mountain filled with bamboos, a giant castle in the air or just have fun in your farm filled with fantasy creatures. 

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
Hop on a server and play some fun mini-games made by the community. Play parkour, puzzle, FPS, or strategy games. Work with or play against your friends. It’s great fun either way!

[b]Community[/b]
Players can interact with other members. Downloading maps or sharing their own work of art with the world.

notes.title: Here We Are 0.25.9 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/8845ad865630f40ba5f079dab96ae44950b39100.jpg[/img]
Here we are monthly update 0.25.9 is here! This new version is mainly to fix bugs and make the terrain editor more easy to use!

1 Self luminescent blocks are now available. (Includes: all light, some blocks and music blocks. They are more beautiful at the night now.


2 You can edit the Plugin within the Terrain editor. This is the most powerful update ever. Add customized blocks,mobs or monsters into any terrains.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/5d1a522f61c5a77deeb3719b4d34eff6b7c3aa98.jpg[/img]


3 You can follow the Connoisseurs now in the Gallery.  Connoisseurs are able to delete their comments now

4 New Dress-up-- Mini T

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557976/fbe213f01c7ee3eb9fdf6add8daeaef950a371ec.jpg[/img]
5 New language (Indonesian) has been added into the game

6 No hacks -If we have detected you are using the Hack, the game will automatically close in 10 seconds. No HACKS in MWBA.

7 UI adjustment to make the description more clear.

Bug fixed
8 Fix the problem in iOS version, the default game language will be based on your system language.

9 Fix the issue of using the Mount or Firework then the game becomes laggy.

10 Fix the Judge mode issue

11 Unified ball type and cube leaf collision properties

12 Fix some Plugin issues

13 Optimize Sniper shooting issue, add a new action and sound effect. Add manual (default), semi-automatic (non-recurring), automatic (continuous) settings

14 Fix the ice-block icon and repair the models of Bunny beauty,Waitress Sweety,Savage Hunter,Penguin,Sulfur Archer

15 Fix the problem when you quit Multiplayer, the blocked list icon will be added into your single saved maps

16 Fix the problem of displaying characters

17 Fix the problem of showing different status even you died

18 Fix some crush issues
